nusmp.beastwill.dragon_will.name: Dragon Will
nusmp.beastwill.dragon_will.lore: The Dragon's Will, an Asuran dragon's will of the Indrath line (Aether) that Sylvia gave to Arthur. A holder first borrows its grip on aether (Static Void); only a trained one becomes the Realmheart dragon-humanoid.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.dragon: Realmheart, my aether, answer: break the realm in two.
The will of a Vritra-corrupted, Hamadryad-like grove guardian. It lends vines and emerald aura, but it pushes back: a holder who is not trained enough is overwhelmed.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.elderwood_guardia: Roots of the elder grove, rise through the rot: Heartwood Lance!
nusmp.beastwill.shadow_panther_will.name: Shadow Panther Will
nusmp.beastwill.shadow_panther_will.lore: A panther of moonless dark that hushes wind and sound until it is only a rumour; the holder first borrows its reflexes, then becomes the silence it hunts in.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.shadow_panther: Wind, hold your breath; sound, lay down your name. Moonless Hush.
nusmp.beastwill.lion_will.name: Lion Will
nusmp.beastwill.lion_will.lore: A pride-king lion's will: the first stage lends a lion's poise and a cub's roar, the second makes a lion king whose howl shakes the ground.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.lion: Kingdom of the golden plain, hear your sovereign. Roar, and the world shall kneel.
nusmp.beastwill.ridge_wolf_will.name: Ridge-Elder Fang Will
nusmp.beastwill.ridge_wolf_will.lore: The will of the elder wolf that rules a mountain ridge: it never loses a trail, hamstrings fleeing prey and calls its pack to the kill.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.ridge_wolf: Moon, lend me your teeth; ridge, close your jaws. The Long Hunt.
nusmp.beastwill.thunder_fang_chimera_wil: The will of a three-bodied storm beast: a lion's fangs, a ram's charge and a venomous serpent tail, all crackling with thunder.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.thunder_fang_chim: Lion bites, ram breaks, serpent binds; sky, answer the three of us. Skyfall of the Chimera.
nusmp.beastwill.crested_boar_will.name: Crested Boar Will
nusmp.beastwill.crested_boar_will.lore: The will of a highland tusker so old its bristle crest has turned to stone: it does not dodge, it walks through the blow and gores.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.crested_boar: Stone crest, unbroken tusk: Avalanche, trample the path!
nusmp.beastwill.wind_skimmer_will.name: Wind-Skimmer Raptor Will
nusmp.beastwill.wind_skimmer_will.lore: The will of an elder raptor that skims the top of the gale: it never lands hard, fades into clouds and falls on prey from the wind.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.wind_skimmer: Open, sky; fall, wind, in a single line. Skimmer's Tempest.
nusmp.beastwill.flame_serpent_will.name: Flame-Serpent Will
nusmp.beastwill.flame_serpent_will.lore: The will of an elder serpent whose scales glow like cooling lava: it senses living heat, hides in heat haze, spits molten venom and coils around what it kills.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.flame_serpent: Cinder coil, molten fang: scorch the sky, Cremation!
nusmp.beastwill.ammit_will.name: Ammit Will
nusmp.beastwill.ammit_will.lore: A mana beast of the dust-lands that weighs the heart of every foe it meets and devours the ones found wanting; its will lets a tamer feel the weight of sin and tear it out.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.ammit: Feather and heart, scales of the dead: Ammit devours the unworthy!
nusmp.beastwill.cerberus_will.name: Cerberus Will
nusmp.beastwill.cerberus_will.lore: A giant mana hound with three snarling heads whose will keeps a threshold: nothing it guards gets out and nothing unwelcome gets in.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.cerberus: Three jaws, one gate: Hellgate, shut for good!
nusmp.beastwill.fenrir_will.name: Fenrir Will
nusmp.beastwill.fenrir_will.lore: A great pale wolf whose will is loyalty itself: a chain-breaker whose jaws gape wide at the end of the world. A will, not a bond: no wolf follows its holder.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.fenrir: Chain of the world, break: Fenrir's jaws open, Ragnarok comes!
nusmp.beastwill.cu_sith_will.name: Cu Sith Will
nusmp.beastwill.cu_sith_will.lore: A green-furred ghost hound of the moors whose paws leave no sound; its will carries a death-omen across mist and heather in a three-fold bark.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.cu_sith: Moor-mist, silent paw: bark three times, Third Bark, sound the omen!
nusmp.beastwill.kitsune_will.name: Kitsune Will
nusmp.beastwill.kitsune_will.lore: A fox spirit whose tails grow with its mana; its will bends light and mind with foxfire and glamour.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.kitsune: Nine tails, one dream. Lantern-fire, light the false road. Kitsune, wake the world asleep.
nusmp.beastwill.nue_will.name: Nue Will
nusmp.beastwill.nue_will.lore: A night-chimera wrapped in black cloud whose cry is an omen: those who hear it fall ill and are struck by lightning.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.nue: Black cloud, cover the moon. Night-bird, cry the omen. Nue, call the storm.
nusmp.beastwill.pegasus_will.name: Pegasus Will
nusmp.beastwill.pegasus_will.lore: A winged stallion of pure light whose hoofbeat can open a healing spring and whose gallop crosses the sky like a falling star.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.pegasus: Hippocrene, carry me; heaven, lend me your bolt. Star Gallop.
nusmp.beastwill.minotaur_will.name: Minotaur Will
nusmp.beastwill.minotaur_will.lore: A bull-headed giant of the stone maze, enraged and untiring, who always finds the way to its prey.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.minotaur: Stone walls, close; no road leads out. Asterion, bellow: the maze has a heart.
nusmp.beastwill.sphinx_will.name: Sphinx Will
nusmp.beastwill.sphinx_will.lore: A winged stone-lion with a calm human face that asks one question and keeps the silence for those who cannot answer.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.sphinx: Four at dawn, two at noon, three at dusk: answer, or be still. The Last Riddle.
nusmp.beastwill.apophis_will.name: Apophis Will
nusmp.beastwill.apophis_will.lore: Apep, the endless serpent that swallows Ra's sun each dusk. Its will has a Vritra-like decay: light dims and life withers around its gaze.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.apophis: Dusk without end, serpent of the dark: swallow the sun, Apep!
nusmp.beastwill.hafgufa_will.name: Hafgufa Will
nusmp.beastwill.hafgufa_will.lore: The Hafgufa floats like an island and breathes a sweet scent that draws fish, then ships, into its maw. Its will is a patient, heavy tide.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.hafgufa: Sweet mist, rise. Deep jaws, open. Island of the dark water, swallow the fleet.
nusmp.beastwill.hydra_will.name: Hydra Will
nusmp.beastwill.hydra_will.lore: The Lernaean Hydra of the marsh: poison breath, many necks, heads that grow back when cut. Its will mends flesh but keeps the holder in pain.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.hydra: Cut one, two shall grow. Nine throats, one hunger. Hydra, bite.
nusmp.beastwill.jormungandr_will.name: Jormungandr Will
nusmp.beastwill.jormungandr_will.lore: The Midgard Serpent circles the world sea with its tail in its mouth; its venom meets Thor at Ragnarok.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.jormungandr: Ring of the world, close your jaws. Midgard's coil, drown the shore.
nusmp.beastwill.kraken_will.name: Kraken Will
nusmp.beastwill.kraken_will.lore: The Kraken of the northern sea: arms that seize ships, ink that blots the sea and a whirlpool when it dives.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.kraken: Dark below the keel, arms of the deep. Kraken, drag the fleet to the floor.
nusmp.beastwill.nidhoggr_will.name: Nidhoggr Will
nusmp.beastwill.nidhoggr_will.lore: Nidhoggr gnaws Yggdrasil's roots in Niflheim and feeds on the dead; its will carries rot and hunger, a Vritra-like decay.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.nidhoggr: Root of the world, grow thin. Niflheim, open your hunger. Nidhoggr, gnaw.
nusmp.beastwill.scylla_charybdis_will.lo: On opposite sides of the narrow strait: Scylla with six snapping dog heads on the cliff, Charybdis the whirlpool beneath.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.scylla_charybdis: Cliff above, current below; no helm may pass. Between Scylla and Charybdis.
nusmp.beastwill.typhon_will.name: Typhon Will
nusmp.beastwill.typhon_will.lore: Typhon, Father of Monsters: a hundred dragon heads that roar with every voice, fire in the eyes and vipers at the thighs.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.typhon: A hundred throats, one storm; hear every voice and break. Hundred-Headed Tempest.
nusmp.beastwill.yamata_no_orochi_will.lo: The eight-headed, eight-tailed serpent of Izumo, with eyes red as winter cherries, brought floods and was drowned in sake.
nusmp.beastwill.incant.yamata_no_orochi: Eight heads drink, eight valleys fill; sake, bring sleep. Eight Valleys Flood.
